title: 沃什：利率决议分歧大，市场已提前反应
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Why should REITS not be higher today? There's a lot in their deal.
segments.zh: 为什么REITS今天不该更高？他们的交易里有很多因素。

segments.en: So rates are higher today than they were 42 days ago.
segments.zh: 所以今天的利率比42天前更高。

segments.en: Markets have made decisions because we step back in part from trying to influence those.
segments.zh: 市场已经做出决定，因为我们部分退出了试图影响这些决定。

segments.en: Market judgments have moved up on what nominal rates are across the Treasury curve.
segments.zh: 市场判断推高了国债收益率曲线上的名义利率。

segments.en: That doesn't mean we take them by dictation, but we're observing them.
segments.zh: 这并不意味着我们接受它们的指令，但我们正在观察它们。

segments.en: So I think it's a mischaracterization to say that markets haven't reacted because we didn't move today.
segments.zh: 所以，说市场没有因为我们今天没行动而反应，是一种误解。

segments.en: Markets are reacting in real time. In the period ahead, we've got important decisions to make about the policy rate.
segments.zh: 市场正在实时反应。未来一段时间，我们将就政策利率做出重要决定。

segments.en: Markets in the intervening period I think have quite a bit of decisions to make.
segments.zh: 我认为在此期间市场有很多决定要做。

segments.en: I'll see if I can put it this way. Monetary policy matters, not just by what we say, or even what we do.
segments.zh: 我试着这样说：货币政策很重要，不仅在于我们说什么，甚至做什么。

segments.en: Monetary policy matters by how it affects the real economy.
segments.zh: 货币政策的重要性在于它如何影响实体经济。

segments.en: And these prices that we see in financial markets is one of the many ways in which it affects the real economy.
segments.zh: 我们在金融市场看到的这些价格，是它影响实体经济的众多方式之一。

segments.en: We'll be continuing to watch that market information, see how it responds to incoming events, and that can help inform our decision making
segments.zh: 我们将继续关注市场信息，观察它如何应对新事件，这有助于我们在七八周后开会时做出决策。

segments.en: when we meet in seven or eight weeks. How would you characterize in the family fight the last couple of days of you and the other eight members who wanted to hold?
segments.zh: 在最近几天的内部争论中，你和另外八位主张维持利率的成员，你们的分歧如何？
